name: Hotel Rauter
beschreibung: Hotel Rauter is set in the alpine village of Matrei in Osttirol, amidst the dramatic peaks of the Hohe Tauern National Park. The hotel blends refined contemporary comfort with warm Tyrolean tradition. In winter, guests enjoy swift transit to the Großglockner Resort Kals-Matrei ski slopes, while summer brings high-alpine hiking trails. Highlights include a luxury wellness area with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, and a renowned award-winning restaurant.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Rauter in Matrei in East Tyrol features award-winning gourmet dining, an upscale spa with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, and Hohe Tauern mountain vistas.
